metadata.description: Final batch to cross 3,000 entity threshold — niche historical films, documentaries, and remaining works.

figures.name: Ip Man
figures.title: Wing Chun grandmaster
figures.description: Legendary martial arts master who trained Bruce Lee, his life during the Japanese occupation of Foshan became the basis for a major film franchise

figures.name: Solomon Northup
figures.title: American memoirist
figures.description: Free African-American man kidnapped and sold into slavery for 12 years, whose memoir became a bestseller and the basis for an Academy Award-winning film

figures.name: Desmond Doss
figures.title: US Army corporal and Medal of Honor recipient
figures.description: Conscientious objector who served as a combat medic at Okinawa, saving 75 men while refusing to carry a weapon, the first CO to receive the Medal of Honor

figures.name: Oskar Schindler
figures.title: German industrialist
figures.description: German businessman who saved 1,200 Jews during the Holocaust by employing them in his factories, spending his entire fortune to keep them alive

figures.name: Wladyslaw Szpilman
figures.title: Polish pianist and composer
figures.description: Polish-Jewish pianist who survived the Warsaw Ghetto and the destruction of Warsaw by hiding in the ruins, his memoir became the basis for The Pianist

figures.name: Hugh Glass
figures.title: American frontiersman
figures.description: Frontier legend who was mauled by a grizzly bear and left for dead by his companions, then crawled 200 miles to civilization seeking revenge

figures.name: Louis Zamperini
figures.title: Olympic athlete and WWII survivor
figures.description: Olympic runner who survived 47 days on a life raft in the Pacific and brutal years as a Japanese POW, later becoming a motivational speaker and forgiveness advocate

figures.name: Eva Peron
figures.title: First Lady of Argentina
figures.description: Argentina's most powerful and controversial First Lady who championed labor rights and women's suffrage, worshipped by the poor and reviled by the elite

works.title: The Hurt Locker
works.creator: Kathryn Bigelow
works.description: Tense war drama following a US Army bomb disposal team in Iraq, the first film by a woman to win the Academy Award for Best Picture

works.title: Black Hawk Down
works.creator: Ridley Scott
works.description: War film depicting the 1993 Battle of Mogadishu when a US military raid went catastrophically wrong in the streets of Somalia

works.title: The Imitation Game
works.creator: Morten Tyldum
works.description: Alan Turing's role in breaking the Enigma code during WWII

works.title: Catch-22
works.creator: Joseph Heller
works.description: Darkly satirical novel about the absurdity of war and bureaucracy following a WWII bombardier trying to maintain his sanity amid the insanity of combat

works.title: Slaughterhouse-Five
works.creator: Kurt Vonnegut
works.description: Anti-war novel about a soldier who becomes 'unstuck in time' after surviving the firebombing of Dresden, blending science fiction with autobiography

works.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
works.creator: Ernest Hemingway
works.description: Novel about an American volunteer fighting with Republican guerrillas during the Spanish Civil War, centering on a dangerous bridge-demolition mission

works.title: A Farewell to Arms
works.creator: Ernest Hemingway
works.description: Semi-autobiographical novel about an American ambulance driver on the Italian front during World War I who falls in love with a British nurse

works.title: The Diary of Samuel Pepys
works.creator: Samuel Pepys
works.description: The most famous diary in the English language, providing an unmatched account of London during the Restoration, including the Great Plague and Great Fire

works.title: The Art of War
works.creator: Sun Tzu
works.description: Ancient Chinese military treatise that has influenced military strategy, business tactics, and legal strategy for over 2,500 years

works.title: The Prince
works.creator: Niccolo Machiavelli
works.description: The foundational work of modern political science, advising rulers that it is better to be feared than loved, shocking readers for 500 years

works.title: Meditations
works.creator: Marcus Aurelius
works.description: The private journal of a Roman emperor on the Stoic philosophy of duty, endurance, and self-improvement — never intended for publication

works.title: The Confessions
works.creator: Augustine of Hippo
works.description: The first Western autobiography, Augustine's account of his spiritual journey from dissolute youth to Christian conversion, a cornerstone of Western literature

works.title: The Histories
works.creator: Herodotus
works.description: The first great work of Western history, recounting the Greco-Persian Wars with digressions into the cultures and customs of the ancient world

works.title: The Republic
works.creator: Plato
works.description: Plato's most famous dialogue exploring justice, the ideal state, and the nature of reality through the Allegory of the Cave and the philosopher-king

works.title: Lives of the Noble Greeks and Romans
works.creator: Plutarch
works.description: Parallel biographies comparing great Greek and Roman figures — Alexander with Caesar, Demosthenes with Cicero — the template for all biographical writing

works.title: The Decameron (novel)
works.creator: Boccaccio
works.description: 100 tales told during the Black Death

works.title: The Golden Ass
works.creator: Apuleius
works.description: The only complete Latin novel to survive from antiquity, a picaresque tale of a man transformed into a donkey, containing the famous story of Cupid and Psyche

works.title: Rashomon and Other Stories
works.creator: Ryunosuke Akutagawa
works.description: Short story collection set in medieval Japan, including the tales that inspired Kurosawa's groundbreaking film about the nature of truth

works.title: Snow Country
works.creator: Yasunari Kawabata
works.description: Elegiac novella about a Tokyo dilettante's affair with a provincial geisha, noted for its crystalline prose and Japanese aesthetic sensibility

works.title: In the Name of the Rose (film)
works.creator: Jean-Jacques Annaud
works.description: Medieval mystery thriller starring Sean Connery as a Franciscan friar investigating murders in an Italian abbey during a period of religious controversy

works.title: The Seventh Seal
works.creator: Ingmar Bergman
works.description: A medieval knight returning from the Crusades plays chess with Death while plague ravages Europe, an existential masterpiece of world cinema

works.title: Andrei Rublev
works.creator: Andrei Tarkovsky
works.description: Epic about the great medieval Russian icon painter, exploring art, faith, and suffering in 15th-century Russia through a series of loosely connected episodes

works.title: Barry Lyndon
works.creator: Stanley Kubrick
works.description: Visually stunning period drama about an Irish rogue's rise and fall in 18th-century European aristocracy, filmed by candlelight with specially adapted NASA lenses

works.title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
works.creator: Werner Herzog
works.description: Expedition descends into madness searching for El Dorado

works.title: Fitzcarraldo
works.creator: Werner Herzog
works.description: Obsessive opera lover attempts to haul a steamship over a mountain in the Peruvian jungle to fund an opera house, with Klaus Kinski actually doing it for the film

works.title: Pan's Labyrinth
works.creator: Guillermo del Toro
works.description: Dark fairy tale set during the aftermath of the Spanish Civil War, in which a young girl discovers a mythical labyrinth while her stepfather hunts Republican guerrillas

works.title: The Spirit of the Beehive
works.creator: Victor Erice
works.description: Poetic film about a young girl in post-Civil War Spain whose encounter with Frankenstein's monster on screen leads her into a haunting inner world

works.title: Dersu Uzala
works.creator: Akira Kurosawa
works.description: Kurosawa's Academy Award-winning Soviet-Japanese co-production about a Russian explorer's friendship with a Siberian hunter, filmed on location in Siberia

works.title: The Leopard
works.creator: Luchino Visconti
works.description: Sumptuous Palme d'Or winner about a Sicilian prince navigating the decline of aristocracy during Italian unification, starring Burt Lancaster

works.title: Senso
works.creator: Luchino Visconti
works.description: Operatic melodrama about an Italian countess's forbidden affair with an Austrian officer during the Italian wars of independence

works.title: Jean de Florette
works.creator: Claude Berri
works.description: French period drama about a hunchbacked city-dweller who inherits a Provencal farm, not knowing his neighbors have blocked the spring that waters it

works.title: Cinema Paradiso
works.creator: Giuseppe Tornatore
works.description: Nostalgic Italian film about a filmmaker recalling his childhood friendship with the projectionist of his village cinema in post-war Sicily

works.title: Spirited Away
works.creator: Hayao Miyazaki
works.description: Animated masterpiece about a girl trapped in a spirit world bathhouse, drawing on Japanese folklore and Shinto mythology

works.title: Mongol
works.creator: Sergei Bodrov
works.description: Epic biographical film about the early life of Genghis Khan, from his childhood captivity to the unification of the Mongol tribes

works.title: Caravaggio
works.creator: Derek Jarman
works.description: Stylized biographical film about the revolutionary Baroque painter whose violent life mirrored the dramatic chiaroscuro of his art

works.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
works.creator: Peter Webber
works.description: Imagined story behind Vermeer's famous painting, following a young servant girl who becomes the artist's muse and model

works.title: At Eternity's Gate
works.creator: Julian Schnabel
works.description: Impressionistic portrait of Vincent van Gogh's final years in Arles and Auvers-sur-Oise, focusing on his fierce devotion to painting despite illness

works.title: Frida
works.creator: Julie Taymor
works.description: Biographical film about Frida Kahlo

works.title: Amadeus
works.creator: Milos Forman
works.description: Mozart's genius through the eyes of his rival Salieri

works.title: Mr. Turner
works.creator: Mike Leigh
works.description: Biographical drama about the last 25 years of the great British painter J.M.W. Turner, capturing his eccentric genius and the changing world around him

works.title: The Nightingale
works.creator: Jennifer Kent
works.description: An Irish convict woman pursues a British officer through the Tasmanian wilderness to seek revenge for a terrible act of violence against her family

works.title: Rabbit-Proof Fence
works.creator: Phillip Noyce
works.description: True story of three Aboriginal girls who escape a government settlement and walk 1,500 miles along a fence line to return to their families

works.title: Beasts of No Nation
works.creator: Cary Joji Fukunaga
works.description: Devastating drama about a young boy forced to become a child soldier in an unnamed West African country torn by civil war

works.title: Waltz with Bashir
works.creator: Ari Folman
works.description: Animated documentary about a filmmaker's attempt to recover his repressed memories of the 1982 Sabra and Shatila massacre during the Lebanon War

works.title: City of God
works.creator: Fernando Meirelles
works.description: Explosive Brazilian crime drama depicting the growth of organized crime in the Cidade de Deus favela from the 1960s to the 1980s, based on true events

works.title: The Lives of Others
works.creator: Florian Henckel von Donnersmarck
works.description: A Stasi officer assigned to spy on a playwright in 1984 East Berlin gradually becomes sympathetic to his targets, winning the Academy Award for Best Foreign Film

works.title: Goodbye, Lenin!
works.creator: Wolfgang Becker
works.description: A young man creates an elaborate fiction to shield his bedridden mother from the knowledge that the Berlin Wall has fallen and East Germany no longer exists

works.title: Underground
works.creator: Emir Kusturica
works.description: Palme d'Or-winning epic satire spanning 50 years of Yugoslav history through the story of two friends, one of whom keeps the other trapped in a cellar during WWII

works.title: A Separation
works.creator: Asghar Farhadi
works.description: An Iranian couple's divorce exposes the tensions of class, religion, and gender in contemporary Tehran, the first Iranian film to win an Academy Award

works.title: Capernaum
works.creator: Nadine Labaki
works.description: A Lebanese boy sues his parents for giving him life in this searing drama about childhood poverty, migration, and survival in Beirut's slums
